originality: Original generation requested for NEON CRONIUM. No external franchise or third-party art was referenced.

generations.prompt: Create a production-ready original 2D SCI-FI ARCADE COMET ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for NEON CRONIUM. Actual transparent alpha background, no text, no labels, no grid, no borders, no ships, no background stars or scenery. ONE HORIZONTAL ROW OF EXACTLY FOUR SEPARATE EQUALLY SIZED SQUARE CELLS, total image aspect ratio 4:1. Each cell shows the SAME small icy mineral comet flying RIGHT along the horizontal +X axis, with its rocky icy nucleus centered at EXACTLY x=76% and y=50% WITHIN EACH CELL, fixed size, fixed camera, fixed position, no tilt or rotation across frames. Nucleus is a beautifully detailed asymmetrical fractured dark blue-gray ice-rock chunk with brilliant frozen white-cyan fissures and small crystalline mineral facets. Its diameter is about 21% of the cell width. A subtle glowing pale cyan coma surrounds the core. A LONG, elegant, narrow tapering comet tail streams to the LEFT, opposite flight direction, beginning directly behind the nucleus and reaching x=8% of the cell. Tail consists of detailed translucent ivory-cyan frozen vapor filaments, ice dust streams, a few tiny angular crystalline fragments, fading into true transparency, no opaque smoke cloud, no orange, red, fire or lava. Do not turn the comet into a missile, spacecraft, fireball, cartoon gem or circular orb. Core must remain legible as an irregular physical rock even at small game scale. Each of the four animation frames MUST HAVE VISIBLY DIFFERENT real vapor structures, small crystalline debris positions, and subtly changing fissure emission while retaining the SAME nucleus center and overall silhouette size: frame1 a straight stream with two thin wisps, frame2 upper wisp opens and 3 ice fragments slip backward, frame3 lower wisp curls and tail splits into three filaments, frame4 wisps converge with another faint burst of tiny ice dust. Smooth continuous looping feel. Stylized realistic volume and elaborate hand-painted game asset material, clean cinematic illustration, controlled cyan light, strong silhouette, coherent lighting upper left. Comfortable fully transparent padding around every cell so no content touches neighbors or edges. The image is artwork for a finished game, not a UI dossier or concept poster.
generations.review: Superseded generation: excessive coma width, tails reach cell boundaries. Preserved as recoverable production history.

generations.prompt: Correct this production comet atlas. Keep the four beautifully textured icy rock nuclei and four genuinely different flowing icy tails. The current pale opaque glow cloud is far too wide and touches every neighboring cell. Redraw the surrounding coma as a MUCH NARROWER faint translucent veil with a delicate thin white-cyan streamer. Remove the thick pale gray background blob surrounding each tail: we need true transparent negative space, not an opaque fog silhouette. Tail should be fine tapering icy filaments fading completely to transparent well BEFORE its left cell edge. Place ALL FOUR separate comets in a 2 by 2 grid this time, with each grid cell square and at least 12 percent transparent padding on all edges. Do not add grid lines or text. Each comet flies horizontally RIGHT, nucleus at x=75 percent,y=50 percent of its own square cell. Fixed nucleus size 18 percent of cell width. Tail streams LEFT from nucleus to x=12 percent, but is only about 10 percent cell tall. No content touches cell edges or each other. Small ice chips can vary around thin tail. Frame1 two thin straight wisps; frame2 upper streamer undulates; frame3 three tapering filaments with one curved filament; frame4 wisps reunite. Original physical dark-blue and silver icy rock, bright fissures, refined volume, not a round sphere, not a missile. Four separate horizontal COMET sprites, complete objects fully visible. Transparent background. No text, no diagrams, no added glowing rectangles.
generations.review: Selected source. Real alpha inspected; independent ice/vapor states, no red/orange material. Normalized with constant nucleus pivot before export.
